## Introduction: 


### Data Acquisition 

#### State Electricity Profiles
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(httr2)
library(rvest)

get_eia_sep <- function(state, abbr){
    library(tidyverse)
    library(stringr)
    library(httr2)
    library(rvest)
    library(fs)
  
    state_formatted <- str_to_lower(state) |> str_replace_all("\\s", "")
    
    dir_name <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
    file_name <- fs::path(dir_name, state_formatted)
    
    fs::dir_create(dir_name, recurse=TRUE)
    
    if(!fs::file_exists(file_name)){
        BASE_URL <- "https://www.eia.gov"
        RESPONSE <- request(BASE_URL) |> 
          req_url_path("electricity", 
                       "state", 
                       state_formatted) |>
          req_headers(
            `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0"
            ) |>   
          req_retry(
                max_tries = 4, 
          ) |>
          req_perform(file_name)
    
        resp_check_status(RESPONSE)
    }
    
    TABLE <- read_html(file_name) |> 
        html_element("table") |> 
        html_table() |>
        mutate(Item = str_to_lower(Item))
    
    if("U.S. rank" %in% colnames(TABLE)){
        TABLE <- TABLE |> rename(Rank = `U.S. rank`)
    }
    
    CO2_MWh <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "carbon dioxide (lbs/mwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |> 
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    PRIMARY <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "primary energy source") |> 
        pull(Rank)
    
    RATE <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "average retail price (cents/kwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        as.numeric()
    
    GENERATION_MWh <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "net generation (megawatthours)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    data.frame(CO2_MWh               = CO2_MWh, 
               primary_source        = PRIMARY,
               electricity_price_MWh = RATE * 10, # / 100 cents to dollars &
               # * 1000 kWh to MWH 
               generation_MWh        = GENERATION_MWh, 
               state                 = state, 
               abbreviation          = abbr
    )
}

EIA_SEP_REPORT <- map2(state.name, state.abb, get_eia_sep) |> list_rbind()
```

#### Energy Consumption (NTD Energy Usage)
```{r}
load_ntd_energy <- function(){
  library(readxl)
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_ENERGY_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_energy.xlsx")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://www.transit.dot.gov/") |>
      req_url_path("sites",
                   "fta.dot.gov",
                   "files",
                   "2026-09",
                   "2025 Energy Consumption_260806.xlsx") |> 
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Energy File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_energy.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  to_numeric_fill_0 <- function(x){
    x <- if_else(x == "-", NA, x)
    replace_na(as.numeric(x), 0)
  }

  read_excel(NTD_ENERGY_FILE) |> 
    select(-c(`Reporter Type`, 
              `Reporting Module`, 
              `Gallons of Other Fuel`, 
              `Other Fuel Description`)) |>
    mutate(across(-c(`Agency Name`, 
                     `Mode`,
                     `TOS`), 
                  to_numeric_fill_0)) |>
    group_by(`NTD ID`, `Mode`, `Agency Name`) |>
    summarize(across(where(is.numeric), sum), 
              .groups = "keep") |>
    mutate(ENERGY = sum(c_across(c(where(is.numeric))))) |>
    filter(ENERGY > 0) |>
    select(-ENERGY) |>
    ungroup()
}

NTD_ENERGY <- load_ntd_energy()
```

#### Transit Service Provided

```{r}
load_ntd_service <- function(){
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_SERVICE_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_service.csv")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://data.transportation.gov/resource/4fir-qbim.csv") |>
      req_url_query(`$query`=paste(
        "SELECT  `_5_digit_ntd_id` AS `NTD_ID`", 
        "`max_agency` AS `AGENCY`",
        "`max_reporter_type` AS `reporter_type`",
        "`max_organization_type` AS `organization_type`",
        "`max_city` AS `city`",
        "`max_state` AS `state`",
        "`mode`",
        "`type_of_service`",
        "`max_primary_uza_code` as `uza_code`",
        "`max_primary_uza_name` as `uza_name`",
        "`max_primary_uza_area_sq_miles` as `uza_sq_miles`",
        "`max_primary_uza_population` as `uza_population`",
        "`max_service_area_sq_miles` as `service_area_sq_miles`",
        "`max_service_area_population` as `service_area_population`",
        "`questionable_record` as `flagged_likely_inaccurate`",
        "`sum_unlinked_passenger_trips_upt` as `total_upt`",
        "`sum_passenger_miles` WHERE caseless_one_of(`report_year`, '2025') limit 50000", 
        sep=",")) |>
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Service File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_service.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  read_csv(NTD_SERVICE_FILE) |>
    mutate(flagged_likely_inaccurate = !is.na(flagged_likely_inaccurate))
}

NTD_SERVICE <- load_ntd_service()
```
## Recoding the Mode Column
```{r}
# List the unique transit mode codes used in the energy data
NTD_ENERGY |> distinct(Mode)

# Translate NTD's two-letter mode codes into readable names.
# Codes and meanings come from the NTD glossary.
recode_mode <- function(x) {
  recode_values(x,
    "AR" ~ "Alaska Railroad",
    "CB" ~ "Commuter Bus",
    "CC" ~ "Cable Car",
    "CR" ~ "Commuter Rail",
    "DR" ~ "Demand Response",
    "DT" ~ "Demand Response Taxi",
    "FB" ~ "Ferryboat",
    "HR" ~ "Heavy Rail",
    "IP" ~ "Inclined Plane",
    "JT" ~ "Jitney",
    "LR" ~ "Light Rail",
    "MB" ~ "Bus",
    "MG" ~ "Monorail/Automated Guideway",
    "OR" ~ "Other Rail",
    "PB" ~ "Publico",
    "RB" ~ "Bus Rapid Transit",
    "SR" ~ "Streetcar Rail",
    "TB" ~ "Trolleybus",
    "TR" ~ "Aerial Tramway",
    "VP" ~ "Vanpool",
    "YR" ~ "Hybrid Rail",
    default = "Unknown"
  )
}

# Apply the same translation to both NTD tables so they still match when joined
NTD_ENERGY  <- NTD_ENERGY  |> mutate(Mode = recode_mode(Mode))
NTD_SERVICE <- NTD_SERVICE |> mutate(mode = recode_mode(mode))
```

1. Which 5 states have the most expensive retail electricity? (Graph)
```{r}
# The 5 states with the highest average retail electricity price
expensive_states <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |>
  slice_max(electricity_price_MWh, n = 5)

ggplot(expensive_states,
       aes(x = reorder(state, electricity_price_MWh),
           y = electricity_price_MWh)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "States with the Most Expensive Electricity",
    subtitle = "Average retail price per MWh",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Price ($ per MWh)",
    caption = "Source: EIA State Electricity Profiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```



2. Which 5 states have the ‘dirtiest’ electricity mix? (Table)


3. On average, how many pounds of CO2 are emitted per MWh of electricity produced in the US? (Note that you will need to use a suitably weighted average here.) (Inline answer)

```{r}

# Weight each state's CO2 rate by how much electricity it generates,
# so big producers like Texas count more than small ones like Vermont
us_avg_co2 <- weighted.mean(EIA_SEP_REPORT$CO2_MWh,
                            EIA_SEP_REPORT$generation_MWh)
```

                            
4. What are the three rarest primary energy sources in the US? What is the associated cost of electricity associated with each source and in what states are they used? (Table answer)

5. My home state, Texas, has a reputation as being the home of “dirty fossil fuels” while NY has a reputation as a leader in clean energy. How many times cleaner is NY’s energy mix than that of Texas? (Inline answer)
```{r}

# How many times more CO2 per MWh Texas emits compared with New York
tx_co2 <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |> filter(abbreviation == "TX") |> pull(CO2_MWh)
ny_co2 <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |> filter(abbreviation == "NY") |> pull(CO2_MWh)
ny_cleaner <- tx_co2 / ny_co2
```
